subject: Re: Private offer — MedStride pilot approvals and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@medstride.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medstride.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer for pilot — initial evidence and approver list

Hi Vivek / Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the throughput and cost controls. Procurement asked me to kick off the private offer path so we can lock pilot pricing and the 9-month term. Two quick asks to move toward an MPO: 

1) Approval matrix: who at MedStride needs to sign (roles/titles) so we can map to AWS buyer approvals.
2) Security evidence: SOC2 summary + data residency confirmation (we can only host in us-east-1).
3) Billing cadence: does Redwood support invoice-to-purchase-order flow, and what is the earliest activation window?

I've attached a short SOW draft and our standard procurement form. Can you confirm the approver matrix and flag any blockers on the 9-month term?

Ellie
Ellie Park
Senior Procurement Manager | MedStride Health
Attachments: MedStride_PO_Template.pdf (form), business_requirements.docx (referenced)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@medstride.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer for pilot — initial evidence and approver list

Hi Ellie — great to hear the team's positive feedback. Short answers and next steps below: 

- Approval matrix: please list the role + email for Finance (PO signoff), Legal (T&C redlines), and IT Security (evidence review). If you prefer, use the template I attached (approval_matrix_template.csv).
- Security evidence: we will provide a SOC 2 summary (attestation) and an evidence checklist. Redwood's hosted option supports us-east-1 data residency; we can pin the MPO to that region.
- Billing: we support invoice + PO activation. Typical activation after PO + signed MPO is 3–5 business days to provision the seller-led activation slot.

To keep momentum, propose this sequence:
  1) You complete approval matrix and confirm PO owner.
  2) We upload the MPO to AWS Marketplace and share the signing link (DocuSign) with your PO owner.
  3) We provide SOC2 summary + evidence pack (redacted) to your security reviewer.

Neha, can you add the SOC2 checklist and the sample evidence spreadsheet for Ellie? Vanessa, flag if legal needs to be looped for any unusual term requests (9-month term is fine from our side — just verify finance cadence).

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: approval_matrix_template.csv
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@medstride.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medstride.com
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for pilot — initial evidence and approver list

Hi Ellie — attaching the SOC2 evidence sheet and a redacted evidence bundle index that should help your IT Security reviewer map items quickly. Highlights:

- SOC2: Type II, most recent report Q4 2027 (we can provide a redacted report under NDA).
- Data residency: confirmed us-east-1; MPO will be pinned to that marketplace region.
- Access: we will provide a read-only audit log export and runbook for incident contacts as part of the MPO activation packet.

Quick ask: please fill the approval_matrix_template.csv with names + emails and return. If procurement wants a shorter term (3 months) as a pilot, call that out in the file and we can offer staged billing.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_evidence_sheet.xlsx (summary), redacted_evidence_index.pdf

Hi all — looping in legal/finance next steps to ensure a smooth MPO signature path. A few items from our side: 

1) Term length: 9 months is OK. If MedStride wants staged termination/early-exit language, we'll need to review in redlines.
2) Activation window: once MPO is accepted by your PO signer, AWS usually requires the seller to confirm activation; our ops team will request a provisioning slot (we have 3–5 business days SLA).
3) DocuSign: I'll create the DocuSign from our standard MPO template and include the SOW as Exhibit A. Ellie, please confirm the PO owner's full name and email so we can route the signature to the correct approver.

Links: DocuSign draft will be here once created — https://www.docusign.com/EXAMPLE_SIGN_LINK
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/DEAL-5142 (internal deal record)

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: MedStride_SOW_draft_v2.pdf
